text: The Patriots are heading to Chicago for Thursday Night Football in Week 7 after a messy but ultimately satisfying 26-19 win over the Jets that left the roster a bit banged up—Romeo Doubs suffered a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch in the first quarter and has now been placed on injured reserve, while A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain was far from seamless, as he dropped a career-high three passes despite the team improving to 2-0 in the AFC East. Drake Maye threw three touchdown passes in the victory, though the film breakdown suggests there's work to be done in the Maye-Brown connection going forward. The Patriots responded to the Doubs injury by signing DB Elliott Davison from the practice squad to the 53-man roster and cycling through some practice squad depth at receiver and offensive line, bringing in WR Ryan Miller and OL Jacob Rizy among others.
